summary:
Iteration 8 frontend-only i18n verification across en/de/fr/es/ja/zh/fi/pl on Home, Guides index, Masterclasses listing, Masterclass detail (propagation), and AI Plant detail (/plants/tomato). The page-level CHROME the previous agent wrapped in t() is correctly translated everywhere (Home feature cards full set incl. 'Open guide' CTA — verified in DE 'Leitfaden öffnen' / ZH '打开指南' / FI 'AVAA OPAS'; Guides index eyebrow/title/intro; Masterclasses list eyebrow/title/intro/courses+lessons labels; Masterclass detail back link, 'MEISTERKURS' eyebrow, 'X von Y abgeschlossen' progress with placeholders, sidebar 'LEKTION N', Previous/Next, 'Erledigt markieren & weiter'; AIPlantDetail spec eyebrows SONNE/WASSER/BODEN/SCHWIERIGKEIT/TOPF/ESSBARER TEIL + GUTE NACHBARN + WO KAUFEN; vendor 'kind' eyebrows SAATGUT/TÖPFE & ERDE/WERKZEUG & ZUBEHÖR). Language persists via localStorage 'patchpot.lang.v1'. ZERO console errors across all language switches.

HOWEVER the underlying user complaint ('far too many areas not being translated') is still demonstrable: the previous agent only wrapped page chrome, but the actual CONTENT — guide card body, masterclass card body, masterclass section headers, lesson eyebrows, and most of AIPlantDetail body — is still pulled from English-only data modules (/app/frontend/src/data/*.js) and from one remaining hardcoded JSX string in Guides.jsx line 285. So when a German user lands on /guides they see a German eyebrow/title/intro but every card title, blurb, and CTA ('OPEN GUIDE') is still English.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded 'Open guide' CTA on every guide card. Translation key home.feature.open_guide already exists in all 31 languages but is NOT used here. In DE it shows 'OPEN GUIDE' instead of 'LEITFADEN ÖFFNEN'. Explicitly called out in the test request.

Lesson eyebrow on content side renders {currentLesson.eyebrow} — hardcoded English from the lesson data (e.g. 'LESSON 1'). The sidebar correctly uses t('mc.lesson_number',{n}) → 'LEKTION 1' in DE, but the matching eyebrow above the lesson title remains 'LESSON 1'. Test request explicitly asks 'Lesson N label' to be translated.

Section header strings come from MASTERCLASS_SECTIONS data: section.label ('FOUNDATION'/'BY FLOWER'), section.title ('Foundations'/'Flower Masterclasses'), section.description ('Three structured courses on the universal skills of growing.' / 'Deep dives into specific flowers …'). All hardcoded English — visible on /masterclasses in every non-English language between the translated intro and the card grid.

Each masterclass card pulls m.duration ('ABOUT 45 MINUTES'), m.title ('Propagation'/'Roses'/'Dahlias'/...), m.tagline directly from ALL_MASTERCLASSES — all hardcoded English. Result: every card on /masterclasses is mostly English in DE/FR/ES/JA/ZH.

Card content uses g.label ('BEGIN TODAY'/'SMALL SPACES'/'ZERO WASTE'/'BRING COLOUR HOME'/'PLANTS HELPING PLANTS'), g.title ('Your First Pot'/'Space-Saving Ideas'/'Regrow from Scraps'/'Cut Flowers'/'Companion Planting'), g.intro — all hardcoded English. In DE the guide cards are entirely English under a German page header.

Plant body content leaks English: plant.category ('VEGETABLE'), plant.title ('Tomato'), plant.description ('Sun-loving fruit that thrives in pots with stakes or cages.'), spec values ('Full sun', 'Regular', 'Rich, well-drained', 'Easy', 'Yes', 'Fruit'), tag chips ('BEGINNER'/'PATIO'/'SUMMER'), and every companion plant card (HERB/FLOWER eyebrow + Basil/Marigold/Nasturtium/Chives/Borage titles + their English descriptions). Only eyebrows and the layout chrome translate. Vendor blurb sub-text shows '…' until LLM fills it (separate cache).
Spec 'TOPF / container' value is hardcoded `plant.container ? 'Yes' : 'No'` instead of t('plant.yes')/t('plant.no'). Renders 'Yes' even in DE/ZH/JA.

Boxes section title (e.g. 'WHAT YOU'LL LEARN') comes from masterclass lesson data and stays English even when the bulleted items inside are AI-translated. The 'Übersetzt' badge appears but the box title doesn't follow it.

action_items: Guides.jsx line 285: replace hardcoded 'Open guide' with t('home.feature.open_guide') (key already populated in all 31 languages).
MasterclassDetail.jsx line 213: replace {currentLesson.eyebrow} with t('mc.lesson_number',{n: currentIndex+1}) so the content eyebrow matches the translated sidebar.

Masterclasses.jsx: stop reading section.label/title/description directly. Either (a) move them into i18n keys mc.section.<key>.label/title/description and look them up via t(), or (b) keep an i18n-key field per section in MASTERCLASS_SECTIONS and translate them.

Internationalise the content data layer: ALL_MASTERCLASSES (title, duration, tagline, lesson.eyebrow, lesson.title, lesson.boxes[].title) and the guides data (label, title, intro). Either embed translations per language in the data file, or push these strings through i18n keys keyed by slug.

AIPlantDetail: internationalise plant.category/title/description/spec values (sun/water/soil/difficulty/edible_part) and companion plant entries. At minimum, replace the literal 'Yes'/'No' on line 102 with t('common.yes')/t('common.no').
MasterclassDetail boxes: feed box.title through i18n (or rely on the existing lesson-adapt translation to also translate box titles, not just body).
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause: i18n work so far has only wrapped JSX-level UI chrome but left the content data modules (/app/frontend/src/data/all-masterclasses.js, plants, guides) as hardcoded English. This is exactly what the user originally complained about. Wrapping JSX in t() does not solve the content-translation problem until the data modules either become i18n-aware or the long-form content goes through the existing /api/lesson-adapt-style translation path.
Guides.jsx has useI18n imported and uses t() in the page header but forgets it on line 285 for the card CTA — clear miss that contradicts the work already done on the Home feature cards.

MasterclassDetail.jsx already destructures { lang, t } and translates the sidebar lesson label, but the duplicate content-side eyebrow on line 213 was left tied to data — easy fix that maintains parity.
MINOR: Masterclasses.jsx line 102 nests a static '✓' inside a translatable string concatenation — fine for now, but consider t('mc.lessons_done') when 100% complete to keep RTL/locale-correct.
MINOR: AIPlantDetail container value 'Yes'/'No' (line 102) should be the only remaining literal in that component — a 30-second fix that visibly helps DE/JA/ZH.

No console errors anywhere during lang switching (en→de→fr→es→ja→zh→fi→pl), no compile errors, localStorage persistence works, and placeholder substitution ('X of Y complete' → '0 von 6 abgeschlossen') works correctly with numeric placeholders preserved.

success_rate.frontend: Page chrome i18n: 100% on listed pages. Content/data i18n: ~40% — Home is fully fixed (data is now i18n-keyed); Guides/Masterclasses lists, Masterclass detail content, and AIPlantDetail body are still mostly English in non-English locales.

seed_data_creation: none — read-only language switching against existing content
context_for_next_testing_agent: When verifying the fixes, set localStorage.setItem('patchpot.lang.v1','de') then reload these pages and visually scan for English: /guides (cards), /masterclasses (section headers + every card), /masterclasses/propagation (lesson eyebrow on content side, 'WHAT YOU'LL LEARN' box title), /plants/tomato (description, spec values, tag chips, companion cards). Home page and all listed page-chrome strings already pass — no need to re-test those exhaustively. Keys home.feature.* and mc.* are fully populated in all 31 languages, so most fixes are 'replace literal with t()' rather than translation additions.
rca of the issue: The previous agent correctly added 67 keys × 31 languages to i18n/index.jsx and wrapped page chrome in Home, Guides header, Masterclasses header, Masterclass detail chrome, AIPlantDetail eyebrows, ShareCard, and FeedbackWidget — those all verify clean. The unfixed surface area is (a) one remaining literal in Guides.jsx line 285 ('Open guide'), (b) MasterclassDetail.jsx line 213 still using data-driven {currentLesson.eyebrow} for the content-side 'LESSON N' label, and (c) the entire content data layer (ALL_MASTERCLASSES, guides data, plants data, MASTERCLASS_SECTIONS) that remains hardcoded English. Reproduce by: localStorage.setItem('patchpot.lang.v1','de'); location.reload(); visit /guides — eyebrow says 'ANFÄNGER-LEITFÄDEN' (good) but every card body and the 'OPEN GUIDE' CTA stays English. Mitigation: see action_items — fix the two JSX literals immediately, and decide on a strategy for the data layer (per-language keys vs. live LLM translation like /api/lesson-adapt already does for lesson bodies).
